findings.summary: F-1-1's fix adds a new autouse fixture `fresh_observability` (lines 53-65 of the worktree file, .claude/worktrees/agent-a5587a7b529c4cdb5/daemon/tests/unit/test_kind_classifier_unit.py) that resets the observability logger and clears the run id before/after each test. daemon/tests/conftest.py already has this exact behaviour as a suite-wide autouse fixture, `_fresh_observability_logger` (conftest.py:43-55: reset_logger(); set_run_id(None); yield; reset_logger(); set_run_id(None)) — it already runs for every test in this file with no opt-in required, including before isolated_xdg_env's monkeypatch.setenv, both defined in the same conftest.py. The new fixture's own setup/teardown calls are fully subsumed by the one conftest already runs; it does not change what XDG_DATA_HOME resolves to or when the singleton re-reads it, so removing it changes nothing observable — it is a second copy of logic the codebase already holds, not a correctness fix. Low severity: no test breaks, no behavior changes, but it is dead redundant fixture code that a future reader has to reconcile against the conftest fixture it silently duplicates.
